# Appeal of Denial — Request for Reconsideration

**RE:** Appeal of adverse benefit determination
**Member:** Quinn Grant
**Member ID:** W914144325
**Reference number:** POC-A7C9BA9551-23896
**Date of denial notice:** August 22, 2026
**Service denied:** Total ankle replacement (CPT 27702)
**Governing policy:** Cigna Medical Coverage Policy 0285 Total Ankle Arthroplasty — https://static.cigna.com/assets/chcp/pdf/coveragePolicies/medical/mm_0285_coveragepositioncriteria_total_ankle_arthroplasty.pdf

Date: [date you send this letter]

To: Cigna Appeals
[appeal address printed on my denial letter]

Dear Reviewer,

I am appealing the denial of the total ankle replacement (CPT 27702) that my surgeon, Dr. Reyes, requested for me. The notice dated August 22, 2026 says the request does not meet the plan's criteria for medical necessity. I am asking Cigna to reconsider that decision, because the criteria published in the plan's own policy — Cigna Medical Coverage Policy 0285 Total Ankle Arthroplasty — line up with what is already in my medical records. My surgeon has documented that this surgery is needed, and the prior authorization packet was submitted with that documentation.

Below I have set the plan's own language next to what my records show.

## 1. Conservative therapy

The plan's policy states:

> "failure of at least six months of conservative therapy (i.e., anti-inflammatory medications, orthotic devices, activity modification, physical therapy)"

My records show:

- I have had **14 months** of progressive ankle pain that is not relieved by rest.
- **Anti-inflammatory medications:** NSAIDs for **6 months**, with inadequate relief.
- **Physical therapy:** supervised physical therapy focused on ankle strengthening and balance, **12 weeks, April 9, 2026 through July 2, 2026, 18 visits completed**, documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- In addition, a **corticosteroid injection on May 18, 2026** gave only about 4 weeks of partial relief.

Treatment has therefore been ongoing across a span well beyond six months, and it has failed to control my symptoms. [If orthotic devices or activity modification were also tried, list them here with dates, and attach the note documenting them.]

## 2. Skeletal maturity

The plan's policy states:

> "individual is skeletally mature"

I am an adult. [Insert my date of birth and age, and cite the chart note or imaging report that documents skeletal maturity.]

## 3. Effect on daily activities and work

The plan's policy states:

> "interferes with the ability to carry out age appropriate activities of daily living and/or demands of employment"

My records document that I walk with an **antalgic gait and am limited to two blocks**, and that my range of motion is limited by pain. [Describe, in my own words, the specific daily activities and job duties I can no longer do, and attach any note from Dr. Reyes describing the same.]

## 4. Condition of the ankle joint

The plan's policy states:

> "presence of ONE of the following in the affected ankle:  severe inflammatory arthritis (e.g., rheumatoid arthritis)  severe osteoarthritis  post-traumatic arthritis"

My weight-bearing ankle radiographs from **July 7, 2026** show **tibiotalar joint space obliteration with subchondral cysts**. On examination I have **positive provocative testing on the affected side** and **range of motion limited by pain**. [Insert the arthritis diagnosis exactly as Dr. Reyes recorded it in the clinical note submitted with the prior authorization.]

## 5. Pain that limits function at short distances

The plan's policy states:

> "individual has moderate to severe ankle pain that:  is function-limiting at short distances (e.g., walking less than ¼ mile, limiting activity to two city blocks, the equivalent to walking the length "

My records state that I am **limited to two blocks** and walk with an antalgic gait. That is the same short-distance limitation the policy gives as its own example.

## 6. Contraindications

The plan's policy states:

> "individual has NONE of the following contraindications to total ankle arthroplasty:  active infection  insufficient bone/osteonecrosis  loss of musculature in the affected limb/insufficient ligament s"

and further lists:

> "Charcot’s or other peripheral neuropathy  neurological impairment  severe ankle deformity precluding proper alignment"

My records document **no active infection**, no untreated substance use, a BMI of 29, and that I am a non-smoker. [Ask Dr. Reyes to confirm in writing that none of the other listed contraindications are present in my affected ankle, and attach that confirmation.]

## A request for the specific criteria applied

Several of the criteria above are introduced by a colon and continue into lists I have not been given in full, so the policy contains further conditions that are not reproduced in this letter. The denial notice tells me only that the request does not meet the plan's criteria for medical necessity; it does not identify which criterion was not met. **I am asking Cigna to tell me, in writing, exactly which criterion or criteria of Cigna Medical Coverage Policy 0285 Total Ankle Arthroplasty the reviewer found unmet, and what evidence would satisfy it.** If any record was missing from the review, I will provide it promptly.

## What I am asking for

I respectfully ask Cigna to overturn the denial and authorize the total ankle replacement (CPT 27702) requested by Dr. Reyes. If the denial is upheld, I ask for a written explanation tied to the specific policy criteria, the credentials of the reviewing physician, and information about my right to a further level of review, including external review.

I understand this appeal must be received by **February 18, 2027**. I am submitting it through my.cigna.com using my plan's appeal form, or by mail to the appeal address printed on my denial letter; the member services number on my card is 1-800-244-6224.

Enclosed with this letter:

- Copy of the denial notice dated August 22, 2026
- Physical therapy discharge note (April 9, 2026 – July 2, 2026, 18 visits)
- Medication record documenting 6 months of NSAID use
- Record of corticosteroid injection, May 18, 2026
- Weight-bearing ankle radiograph report, July 7, 2026
- Office notes from Dr. Reyes
- [Any additional records listed here]

Thank you for taking another look at this.

Sincerely,

**Quinn Grant**
Member ID: W914144325
[Street address]
[City, State ZIP]
[Phone number]
[Email address]

*This letter is not medical or legal advice and does not guarantee that coverage will be approved.*
